_comment: Patient-facing errors from booking_requests.py's _analyze_referral and _create — never the admin surface.
booking.error.catalog_unavailable: We could not look up the services right now. Try again in a few minutes.
booking.error.center_mismatch: That service is not offered at the chosen center. Pick the service again from the list.
booking.error.center_not_found: The center for this appointment is no longer available. Pick the service again from the list.
booking.error.doctor_not_found: The professional you picked is no longer available. Pick another time.
booking.error.doctor_not_in_service: That professional does not see patients for this service. Pick another time.
booking.error.active_limit_detail_many: You already have {abiertas} {servicio} appointments requested and not yet seen, which is the maximum. To request another, cancel one of them in My appointments and request a new one.
booking.error.active_limit_detail_one: You already have {abiertas} {servicio} appointment requested and not yet seen, which is the maximum. To pick another time, cancel the one you have in My appointments and request a new one.
booking.error.invalid_account_dni: your account doesn't have a valid DNI
booking.error.no_show_blocked_detail: Because of your recent no-shows, this appointment can't be requested online. Please go to the hospital or the health center so we can help you.
booking.error.no_show_blocked_detail_cen: Because of your recent missed appointments, this appointment can't be requested online. Visit the admissions desk and we'll help you: {place}.
booking.error.rate_limited: You've made several requests in a row. Wait a few minutes and upload it again. If it's urgent, book from Services and Centers or at the health center.
booking.error.upload_abuse: You've uploaded several documents we couldn't recognize as a referral. Wait a bit, or book the appointment by hand.
booking.upload.ai_down: The automatic referral reader isn't available right now.
booking.upload.ai_down_alternative: You can still book the appointment: pick the service, upload the referral at the right step, and the hospital will review it. No need to wait.
booking.upload.ai_down_link: See services and book an appointment
booking.upload.ai_down_meta: The referral reader isn't available right now. You can still book the appointment by uploading the referral.
booking.upload.meta: Upload the referral your doctor gave you: we'll tell you which appointment to book and how to prepare.
booking.upload.subtitle: Upload the referral your doctor gave you. We'll read it and tell you which appointment to book and how to prepare.
booking.upload.title: Upload your referral
booking.error.horizon_detail: That day is not open for booking yet. Choose an available time in the service calendar or visit the health center.
booking.error.horizon_detail_center: That day is not open for booking yet. Choose an available time in the service calendar or visit the admissions desk: {place}.
